The Fiber license is from its v8.18.0 release:
https://github.com/pmndrs/react-three-fiber/blob/v8.18.0/LICENSE

ShaderGradient's package metadata and repository README identify the renderer as
MIT. Its repository supplies the copyright notice in the README rather than a
standalone license file: “MIT © ruucm, stone-skipper.” `shadergradient.LICENSE`
reproduces that notice with the standard MIT permission text.
Source: https://github.com/ruucm/shadergradient#license

The build also copies available license files from bundled npm dependencies into
`extension/assets/visuals.js.LEGAL.txt`, alongside esbuild's preserved notices and
the Liquid Glass license.
